El Niño impact could cause significant economic loss in India

The El Niño phenomenon is projected to have a substantial and long-lasting impact on India's climate, agriculture, economy, and daily life. Reports suggest potential economic losses and a crisis of drought, famine, and inflation due to its effects on the monsoon.
